STATUS: fail
SUMMARY: I found no reproduced functional breakage. Overflow, filter URL state, XSS-style genre input, form validation, and file:// all held under my probes. The failures are coverage gaps: two criteria have no test (text contrast, reduced motion), and the test count in the handoff doesn't match the file.
FILES TOUCHED: none. Probes and mutant copies are in /tmp/claude-0/-tmp-ff-eval-mv-e9x3f-workspace/c64675ad-fb1b-4e3e-befa-7d8c152cb78c/scratchpad/. `git status` matches the start.
FINDINGS:
- [blocking] No test for WCAG text contrast or prefers-reduced-motion. Mutant copy: `--ink-soft: #5c4d3f` → `#a9a095`, then `node tests/run.mjs --grep focus` and `--grep catalogue` both still pass. My own probe (computed colours, 563 text nodes, 5 page states, 1280 and 360px) found 0 failures, so the criterion holds today, but nothing guards it. Reduced motion: 0 animated or transitioning elements under `reducedMotion: reduce`, also untested.
- [minor] Without JS, Books shows "" and 0 cards, Home picks are empty, and Events shows an empty list with its message hidden. Reproduced. The spec doesn't require JS-off.
- [minor] `?genre=mystery!` silently selects Mystery with no note, because the slug strips the punctuation. Reproduced.
- [minor] Menu open at 360, then resized to 1024: the hidden toggle keeps `aria-expanded="true"`. Reproduced.
- [minor] Menu open, click the h1, press Escape: focus jumps to the Menu button. Reproduced.
- [minor] Email regex accepts `x@y..z`. Reproduced; the spec only names `a@` and `foo`.
- [minor] `node tests/run.mjs --grep` with no value makes `grep` undefined, so every test runs. Read from code, not run.
- [minor] file:// is only tested for Books and Home. I probed Events and Visit from file://: they render and have no console errors.
CHECKS:
- scrollWidth at 320/360/768/1280 on all 4 pages, plus menu open at 320/360 → pass, equal to viewport width.
- 400-char and 300-char unicode `?genre=` at 320/360 → pass, no overflow.
- Keyboard menu at 320 on each page (Tab×3, Enter, Tab → Home, Escape → nav hidden, focus on toggle) → pass.
- Property, 1012 seeded `?genre=` inputs via popstate (`<script>`, `%00`, RTL, emoji, 3000 chars): checked/count/note/no-script invariants → 0 failures, 0 page errors.
- Property, 400 seeded form submissions (blank, whitespace, bad emails, 5000 chars, HTML): aria-invalid, describedby, focus, demo-only, no dialogs → 0 failures.
- URL variants (`mystery&genre=poetry`, `Science+Fiction`, `science%20fiction`, `%20mystery%20`, `GENRE=`, `#frag`), back/forward chain incl. an unknown-genre entry, arrow-key radio change → pass.
- Mutants: `event.date > today` fails the midnight test; `innerHTML` for the note fails never-html; `aria-current` removed fails pages-share. Those tests can fail.
- No external requests across all pages, including filter and submit. No lorem ipsum. No duplicate ids. Cover divs are aria-hidden. All 5 events fall on Saturdays, matching the copy.
- Money and command-output checks: N/A, the diff has no user-entered numbers and no CLI output.
OPEN QUESTIONS:
- The handoff says "currently 28 passed", but tests/run.mjs defines 31 `test(` blocks. I did not re-run the suite as instructed, so the orchestrator should confirm the actual PASS/FAIL list before accepting.
- Should Books, Events and Home degrade without JS? The spec doesn't say.
